item.title: Ask HN: Why do talentless hacks hate AI?
item.summary: Good artists in every medium embrace it, find it a giddy technology. Only those who were never very talented hate on it and refuse it. Creative types can’t help but use it and love it. It’s the most creative invention of our time. The only people against it are gatekeepers who gain value in their careers through status and politics - not by creative production. Short of a $200k/yr salary and free catered meals, what would it take to win over the charlatans and hacks that plague our creative space and vie for our work? Or should we just laugh at these pathetic dweebs and feel sorry at best? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49434799 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
